title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
description: After their unprecedented victory in the 74th Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark embark on a Victors Tour. Katniss senses rebellion is stirring, but a cruel change in the upcoming 75th Hunger Games may change Panem forever.

title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
description: After shattering the games forever, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) finds herself in District 13, fighting to save Peeta (Josh Hutcherson) and a nation moved by her courage.

title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
description: Katniss faces mortal traps, deadly enemies and moral choices when she and her closest friends leave District 13 to assassinate President Snow and liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem.

title: The Condemned
description: A death-row inmate from a Central American jail is among the prisoners taken to a remote island for a to-the-death match broadcast live over the Internet.

title: The Condemned 2
description: A former bounty hunter (Randy Orton) lands in a tournament where convicts fight to the death for an online audience.

title: Dig
description: Held hostage by a dangerous couple, a widower and his daughter must work together to outsmart their captors and survive the night.

title: Braven
description: A logger and his father head to their hunting cabin, hoping for a quiet weekend. Instead, they find themselves in a kill-or-be-killed stand for survival when they encounter a gang of ruthless drug traffickers.

title: Divergent
description: In a future society, people are divided into factions based on their personalities. After a young woman (Shailene Woodley) learns she is a Divergent and will never fit into any one group, she uncovers a conspiracy to destroy all those like her.

title: The Divergent Series: Insurgent
description: Fugitives Tris and Four search for allies and answers among the ruins of Chicago while arduously trying to evade Jeanine, leader of the Erudite.

title: The Divergent Series: Allegiant
description: As a ruthless battle threatens humanity, Tris and Four journey beyond the wall that encloses Chicago to find a peaceful solution for their embroiled city.

title: Stand Up Guys
description: A geriatric gangster's (Al Pacino) release from prison leads to a reunion with his two partners in crime (Christopher Walken, Alan Arkin), one of whom has orders to kill him.

title: The Hard Word
description: Three brothers have numerous scores to settle after their partners-in-crime betray them during a racetrack robbery.

title: Montana
description: A crime boss pursues his girlfriend and two blackmailed gang members (Kyra Sedgwick, Stanley Tucci) trying to nab her.

title: Jawbone
description: A former boxing champion, long past his prime, returns to his childhood boxing club. He reunites with his old corner man and promoter, hoping the team can teach him to stand tall once more.

title: Born a Champion
description: A former Marine prepares for a jujitsu rematch against a bruising opponent who cheated during their first encounter.

title: Never Back Down
description: A rebellious teenager (Sean Faris) learns to fight from a veteran (Djimon Hounsou) of mixed martial arts after joining an underground fight club.

title: Southpaw
description: After losing everything to a senseless tragedy, a boxer (Jake Gyllenhaal) turns to a retired fighter (Forest Whitaker) for guidance as he struggles toward redemption.

title: Alex Cross
description: In Detroit, a cunning serial killer (Matthew Fox) pushes young detective and psychologist Alex Cross (Tyler Perry) to his moral and psychological limits.

title: Above Suspicion
description: A young woman desperately tries to escape a seedy life of crime and drugs in a Kentucky coal mining town. She believes her bad luck may finally be changing when a newly minted FBI agent recruits her as an informant for a high-profile case.

title: Precious Cargo
description: To get back in the good graces of her murderous boss (Bruce Willis), a seductive thief (Claire Forlani) recruits an ex-lover (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) to steal rare and valuable gems.

title: Damaged
description: When a sadistic murderer surfaces in Scotland, terrified local authorities call on a Chicago detective who investigated a killing spree with the same horrific pattern five years earlier.

title: Bangkok Dangerous
description: A hitman who's in Bangkok to pull off a series of jobs violates his personal code when he falls for a local woman and bonds with his errand boy.

title: The Protégé
description: Rescued as a child by the legendary assassin Moody, Anna is the world's most skilled contract killer. However, when Moody is brutally killed, she vows revenge for the man who taught her everything she knows.

title: 24 Hours to Live
description: After a mercenary dies in a brutal firefight, a new regenerative surgery gives him a second chance at life and another shot at redemption.

title: Ticker
description: A renegade cop (Tom Sizemore) teams with explosives expert (Steven Seagal) in order to stop a mad bomber (Dennis Hopper) in Los Angeles.

title: Lucky Number Slevin
description: A conflict between black and Jewish gangsters in New York City and a case of mistaken identity land a man (Josh Hartnett) in the middle of a revenge plot of a crime boss (Morgan Freeman).

title: Patriots Day
description: In the aftermath of the Boston Marathon bombings, police Sgt. Tommy Saunders, FBI Special Agent Richard DesLauriers and Commissioner Ed Davis join survivors, first responders and other investigators in a race against time to find the suspects.
